newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA'S NDOLA LIME RESUMES EXPORTS TO NEIGHBOURS.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA'S NDOLA LIME RESUMES EXPORTS TO NEIGHBOURS.

text.p: Zambia's Ndola Lime Company said on Friday it would resume exports to neighbouring countries after a six-month break caused by production problems.

"Ndola Lime Company last month resumed exporting its products to its main customers in Zimbabwe, South Africa, Namibia and Malawi in order to raise the much needed foreign exchange for the purchase of spare parts," a company official told Reuters.

The company earlier this year stopped exports of lime to Zambia's neighbours due to heavy fuel oil shortages, so as to meet the needs of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM), which uses 85 percent of its lime output.
Ndola's production was affected by a fall in heavy fuel oil supplies at the state-run Indeni oil refinery.
The low lime output pushed ZCCM copper production down to 21,380 tonnes in April, against an official estimate of 27,057 tonnes. Copper production in March was 32,051 tonnes.
